file_ref: CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased, the codes-exit and codes-stored paragraphs)
summary: [standards] Two stage paragraphs of the 0.36 CHANGELOG entry still state STOPPED_MIDWAY as the live behaviour of 0.36, against the table, the Gone list and the upgrade note of the same section: the codes-exit paragraph says a staged record whose promotion the gate refused 'is STOPPED_MIDWAY (exit 1, reason PROMOTION_INVALID)' and that strategy promote 'is STOPPED_MIDWAY with reason STRATEGY_PROMOTION_INVALID'; the codes-stored paragraph says a blob rewritten during upload 'is STOPPED_MIDWAY (reason ARTIFACTS_BLOB_CORRUPT)'. The old-name tests exempt the CHANGELOG, so nothing catches it; a release owner or script author reading top-down meets a code that 0.36 does not register. Rewrite them to EVIDENCE_INCOMPLETE, STRATEGY_INCOMPLETE and ARTIFACTS_MOVE_INCOMPLETE (or mark them 'was STOPPED_MIDWAY in the stage, now ...'). The table row, Gone list and upgrade note are right.
